notable_absence.finding: As with add-eventing-functions.md, the deploy/undeploy UI flow (Data Tools > Eventing > More Options > Deploy/Undeploy) names no privilege, capella-role, or credential type gate. Deployment appears to be gated purely by Function lifecycle state (must be undeployed to deploy, must be deployed to undeploy) rather than by an access-control predicate documented on this page. This directly answers the batch hypothesis for this page: no Eventing-specific privilege or capella-role surfaces here - the only gate found is state-based, not access-control-based.

cross_component_finding: Deploying a Function is described as a multi-effect operation - 'Creates necessary metadata', 'Spawns worker processes', 'Calculates initial partitions', 'Initiates checkpointing of processed stream data' - none of which reference the collection/scope model directly; the metadata creation ties to the Eventing Storage keyspace set in add-eventing-functions.md rather than being described fresh here.
